text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Listen, Trainer. Everyone is calling for 
me."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's looking at me. Believing that 
I'm the number one Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer. Um, you know... About 
me...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Did I manage to... stay in everyone's 
memories?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Did I manage to become... the number one 
Umamusume, more than anyone ever 
before...!?

Standing in the winner's circle, a place 
reserved only for the Umamusume who took 
first place. Hearing the deafening roar of 
congratulations all around.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*! No more looking uncool. 
Everyone is waiting for me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Alright, hurry up and get ready yourself!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the award ceremony is starting soon, 
right? The reporters are bound to swarm 
you even more than before!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because when that time comes, you'll need 
to introduce me like this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"She's the absolute best Umamusume I've 
ever trained, and the Umamusume I'm most 
proud of!" That's what!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"She's the absolute best Umamusume I've 
ever trained, and the Umamusume I'm most 
proud of!" That's what!!

—And led by the hand by Daiwa Scarlet, I 
accompanied her to the winner's podium.
